part_a: Absolute time equivalent of saved cyclic daily phase discrepancy (1 cycle/day, 14-day windows, 1-day step)

part_b.analysis_time: Calendar centers, raw timestamps and actual per-bin mean source times retained
part_b.own_clock_note: Oracle localdatetime; timezone and clock correspondence unconfirmed
part_b.amplitude: Linear empirical 90th percentile of absolute q at unshifted anchors on each grid
part_b.selection: Positive upper fine amplitude; two fixed eligible windows (max, nearest median excluding max); earlier ties
part_b.fixed_support: Both channels have q at each shifted anchor; q requires adjacent occupied calendar cells
part_b.perturbations: Window ±1 day, two background alternatives, each day, C extrema, both cells forming max |q| per sensor, full 2h subset
part_b.peak_criterion: All required core curves defined; unique interior envelope candidate with lower correlation > 0. Full-bin variant included only when jointly supported. A stable discrete peak alone does not establish a resolved delay.
part_b.ties: 64 machine epsilons for Pearson equality only
part_b.sensitivity: Min/max across defined variants, not a statistical confidence interval
